about: The secreta of the formulary “23rd Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We offer You, O Lord, the sacrifice of praise that we may serve You even better, so that You may graciously complete what You have given us, Your undeserving servants. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,
